screen.severownercontrolpanel.title: Server Management Panel
screen.severownercontrolpanel.players_hi: Enter a player and group name to manage groups and panel access. Buttons run the matching /socp operation.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.groups_hin: Use a color name or hexadecimal value, for example red or #41C7A3.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.group_colo: Available: red, blue, purple, green, lime, yellow, gold, orange, aqua, cyan, pink, magenta, white, gray, black, dark_red, dark_green, dark_blue, dark_purple, teal, brown.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.rules_hint: Triggers: join, first_join, interval, death, respawn. Actions: message, give, effect, teleport, clear_effects.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.respawns_h: Saving the current position uses the target player's coordinates. Coordinates use x y z.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.teleport_h: Target accepts a player name, group name or all. Coordinate teleporting uses the executor's dimension; the owner button teleports targets to the owner's dimension and position.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.blocked.em: This player currently has no active blocked or cooled items; rules set on the player and inherited from their groups both appear here
screen.severownercontrolpanel.blocked.hi: The list contains the player's own rules and rules inherited from their groups, with the source shown next to each item. Click an item row to open the edit menu for usable state or cooldown. The batch field accepts ranges (number-number) mixed with single or multiple indexes separated by commas, e.g. 1-3,5; leave it empty and press the button to toggle every item in the list. Indexes match row numbers; out-of-range indexes are ignored.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.group_list: No recorded players in this group yet; add players on the Players page first
The input was a group name: click a player to open their blocked item list.
The button toggles the usable state of this item at once; cooldown accepts decimals (e.g. 1.5) and applies to this player's use of the item; clearing restores the default 0 seconds.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.items_hint: Field A accepts a group name, player name or UUID. Field B accepts an item ID (e.g. minecraft:stick) or a localized item name, resolved before sending. The state button shows the current result and toggles on click. Forbidden items cannot be used by the player. The clear button removes the disabled and cooldown settings of every target at once; changes are written to disk only after saving.
screen.severownercontrolpanel.cooldown_i: Enter a number greater than zero and no larger than 32767 (16-bit integer limit); decimals such as 1.5 are allowed
screen.severownercontrolpanel.cooldown_h: Enter the cooldown in seconds; decimals such as 1.5 are allowed. After truncating to int it must be greater than zero and no larger than 32767 (the 16-bit integer limit). The original value is applied to the group or player in field A; restoring the default resets the cooldown to 0 seconds.
message.severownercontrolpanel.item_bloc: You are not allowed to use this item.
message.severownercontrolpanel.item_cool: This item is on cooldown. Wait %s more second(s).
message.severownercontrolpanel.no_permis: You do not have permission to use management features.
message.severownercontrolpanel.first_joi: Welcome to the server. First-join rules executed.
